hero.kicker: Jyotirlinga & Shakti Peeth · Srisailam, Andhra Pradesh
beats: Two brothers raced around the world
Ganesha circled his parents and won
Hurt Kartikeya left for Krauncha hill
Shiva and Parvati followed to Srisailam

beats.line: Shiva and Parvati set their two sons a race
Kartikeya flew far; Ganesha circled his parents
Hurt, Kartikeya went alone to the Krauncha hills
Shiva and Parvati stay near him at Srisailam
